historical_trace_policy: union of exact integer-radius algebraic arc cell hits with all incidence ties retained

minimality.r1_r2_statement: Every fully contained cell through radius 2 has q-range containing integer square 1 or 4 and is therefore historically perimeter-hit.
minimality.r3_uniqueness: Among the ten fully contained sector cells at radius 3, D(1,1) is the unique cell whose q-range contains none of 1,4,9.

general_lifetime_hidden_criterion: A sector cell C is never hit by any integer-radius perimeter iff [q_min(C),q_max(C)] contains no positive integer square. It becomes fresh hidden at r=ceil(sqrt(q_max(C))) when full containment is adopted.
scope: single chamber Q0 / sector S0 only; no global chamber gluing is claimed
